milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the spruce door at spawn-relative (0, 1, 6) and face it, modeling 'player can see the door'. Max distance of 5 blocks ensures the player has clearly found and approached the door, and facing_tolerance of 60 degrees ensures they are looking at it. This is the preferred rule type for find/observe tasks.

Uses position_near_with_facing with a tight max_distance of 2 blocks because the player must be within right-click interaction range to close the door. Combined with count_in_box_at_least to confirm the door block still exists (wasn't broken). While the available rule types cannot directly verify the door's open/closed block state (voxels only reports type, not properties), the tight proximity requirement (2 blocks, vs 5 for the find task) ensures the player deliberately moved into interaction range — a necessary precondition for closing the door. Facing tolerance of 60 degrees ensures the player is aimed at the door.
